$doc: SINGLE SOURCE for the Foresight crowd-share allow-list (S13 / CROWD-share). Edit THIS file, then run `python pipeline/gen_crowd_schema.py` to regenerate the three mirrors: Foresight/data/generated/crowd_schema.lua (addon), web/crowd-schema.js (web sanitize), and the validContribution block in web/firestore.rules (server gate). The ship gate (pipeline/run_tests.py) fails if any committed mirror has drifted from this file, so a new field can never silently land in one consumer and leak past another. DATA-MINIMIZATION LAW: this is an ALLOW-LIST - only the fields named here may leave a player's machine. 'tier' is 'anon' (non-identifying game data, the only tier today) or 'identifying' (opt-in, off by default - gated behind a 'named' flag; reserved for the show-off tier). See docs/S13-CROWD-BACKEND.md and Foresight/core/crowd.lua.

fields.doc: client build id (game data, not identity)
numeric spec id only, never a name
opt-in flag: show me on named leaderboards; GATES name/armory
chosen display HANDLE (not legal name); allowed only when named==true
optional armory URL (https only, charset-locked); allowed only when named==true
buff provenance spellId->name (game data, shown on records)
